I am a 71 year old medical equipment service tech with 35 years' experience and would like to share some tech tips after installing the DW myself. The installation and instruction manuals are very complete and YouTube videos will fill in the knowledge gaps that are missing. Factory technical support is excellent. The only printed mistake involves the air gap instructions. The large hose goes to the garbage disposer drain from the air gap and the smaller hose from the DW goes to the smaller diameter side arm barb of the air gap. The feet will adjust easily if you pry up on the machine frame to take the weight off the adjusters. The universal brackets are excellent if you plan appropriately. I had to move the electrical MC from behind the DW to the adjacent cabinet with a new electrical box, wiring, and GFCI outlet to meet the new code requirements. I did this myself but it is not an average DIY project, I highly recommend a licensed electrician. Do not use the available Bosch junction box because the wire size is underrated for the current draw. The cabinet cutout size and location is perfect, do not make it smaller. The benchmark model I purchased had the upgraded parts installed, specifically the reinforced fill tube with sprinkler and zeolite ring nut redesign. The dishes are sparkling clean! You cannot hear the DW running and the silverware rack and internal lights are an elegant upgrade. I have not downloaded or used the app which appears to not be ready for prime time. I am very happy with the DW after four weeks and four washes; hopefully it will last for many more.

We just open it, shake the plastic, and let it air dry.Lastly, we thought the towel bar handle would be convenient. Comments (English): [ Samsung StormWash ] || ---------------- || Our Fridgedaire Professional dishwasher pooped out so we were on the look out form a replacement. I also look at Costco for appliances because their warranty and service can't be beat. This dishwasher is fantastic. The adjustable racks are great but the designated silverware rack is the true gem. I've always had issues with the silverware not quite getting clean but this setup alleviates that issue. The dishwasher is exceptionally quiet. We have an open concept and our dishwasher is less than 10 feet from where we sit and watch tv. While I run it at night 99% of the time, I have occasionally run it during the day and you barely know it's going. I've seen some complaints about there not being a “dry” selection. I've never had an issue. While there is some water trapped here in there in the lip of plastic items, everything else comes out completely dry. The only thing I'm not 100% satisfied with is the bottom rack. We have fairly heavy duty dishes and the tines that hold the plates upright are too close together. I have to put plates in every other spot to make sure they get fully cleaned. Not really a problem as much as it was a surprise.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher a week ago, and I absolutely love the sleek look and features of it.
Comments (English): [ Dishes don't clean well and come out super wet ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher a week ago, and I absolutely love the sleek look and features of it. However, that's where it ends for me because as excited as I was to replace my old dishwasher that has a bad pump, this dishwasher was a total letdown for me. It doesn't clean very well even with the heavy option selected, boost settings, hi temp, and sanitize options all set. I have experimented with rinse aid settings ranging from the default setting of F4, scaling it back to F1 and raising it all the way up to F6, which is the highest setting. My dishes always come out super wet even after waiting for an hour after the cycle completes with the auto door opener on. I've tried the most expensive pods, detergent booster, liquid detergent, and powder detergent with no good results at all in all of the settings I've tried. I really wanted to like this dishwasher because it matches my samsung fridge, but my old Kitchenaid was way better with washing and drying the dishes. I had high expectations for this to be equal or even better since it connects to the Smart Things app, but it's nowhere near close to the same performance. I'll be returning this either for a full refund or an exchange for a different brand, hoping to have a much better experience and better results.

Even when I used it for 12 people, I often used pots and frying pans by hand, so when I received it, it was huge, but it was just right when I actually used it. The price difference was whether or not it had an automatic door opening, so I was a full-time housewife and spent a lot of time at home, so I thought for a while whether to buy a cheaper one without an automatic door opening, but I thought there must be a reason why people who have used it recommend one with an automatic door opening, so I chose one with an automatic door opening. Cook looked similar to Samsung, but there wasn't much difference in price, so I finally chose Samsung 6-inch based on the brand image. After using it, I put in the powder detergent I used before, and There are still water marks even after using rinse, but I'm going to try changing the detergent. If you don't need that, the windowless model offers better value for money. I looked up to 350,000 won. It has upper, middle, and lower wings for washing, and the water from the bottom reaches the top, so you can consider the cleaning power to be similar to other products. As for water stains and detergent residue, that is actually mostly influenced by the detergent, so I don't think that is a subject for discussion. This product was good for narrow kitchens because it has a shallow depth like the LG Objet (LG does not have automatic door opening). If you have plenty of space and budget, you should go with Samsung. It is 100,000 won more expensive, and adding hot air drying seems to cost around 200,000 won. Alternatively, there are smaller companies like Cuckoo.

This product was good for narrow kitchens because it has a shallow depth like the LG Objet (LG does not have automatic door opening). Sentence (English): This dishwasher (DW) seems to do a good job getting my dishes clean.
Comments (English): [ Review of the Samsung Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher (DW) seems to do a good job getting my dishes clean. There's a learning curve in exploring how to best use its features and in loading the dishes, flatware, pots & pans, and other differently shaped dishes. The information booklet is useful to a point with this. The flatware/utensil baskets that came with the DW I found to sit/be too high so I haven't been using them. I probably will attempt to use them at some point. Another learning curve issue. The other issue I have is with needing to leave the door to the DW ajar all the time, as it seems that if I close it up (empty of dishes) it seems to have a “moist”smell upon opening. It never dries out completely. The quiet operation is amazing and I do like that the door pops open very close to the end of each wash cycle - this does help with drying.

Sentence (English): I have a large family, and after more than 10 years of marriage, I finally got a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I have a large family, and after more than 10 years of marriage, I finally got a dishwasher. I didn't think much about a dishwasher because I didn't feel bad about doing the dishes myself, and I had a goal of making rules with my family and doing housework, but I ended up always having to do all the housework. I work a second job and am preparing to start my own business, and the piled-up dishes seem to be blocking my path, so I got annoyed and bought it. It's easy to use, has a water tank, and comes with an extra installation hose, so you can choose the installation method you want, which is nice. When it was delivered and I unpacked it, the box was easy to take out. I brought it in as a box and just unpacked it right next to where I wanted to install it! The black color is neat and pretty. I was originally going to buy a cheaper, smaller one for 2-3 people, but I'm glad I didn't buy that. It's bigger than I thought for 6 people, and since we're a large family, it would have been better if it were bigger, but the sink size is just right. I put it back on before going to work in the morning, and when I came back, the door opened automatically and the dishes were well dried. Today, there are no piled-up dishes, and it's so nice to save time because I don't have to stick to the kitchen. I'll use it well.

I didn't think much about a dishwasher because I didn't feel bad about doing the dishes myself, and I had a goal of making rules with my family and doing housework, but I ended up always having to do all the housework. I work a second job and am preparing to start my own business, and the piled-up dishes seem to be blocking my path, so I got annoyed and bought it. It's easy to use, has a water tank, and comes with an extra installation hose, so you can choose the installation method you want, which is nice. When it was delivered and I unpacked it, the box was easy to take out. I brought it in as a box and just unpacked it right next to where I wanted to install it! The black color is neat and pretty. I was originally going to buy a cheaper, smaller one for 2-3 people, but I'm glad I didn't buy that. It's bigger than I thought for 6 people, and since we're a large family, it would have been better if it were bigger, but the sink size is just right. I put it back on before going to work in the morning, and when I came back, the door opened automatically and the dishes were well dried. Today, there are no piled-up dishes, and it's so nice to save time because I don't have to stick to the kitchen. I'll use it well.

Sentence (English): When I was married and taking a break, I didn't really need a dishwasher.
Comments (English): When I was married and taking a break, I didn't really need a dishwasher. But after having a child and growing up, I realized there were so many dishes left after every meal that I felt like hand-washing was a waste of time. While searching for dishwashers for major companies, I stumbled upon this cost-effective Media Dishwasher through an algorithm! I was a bit hesitant because there weren't many reviews, but most people seemed very satisfied, so after a week of deliberation, I ordered it through Coupang. The delivery person contacted me to set up an installation date, and after measuring, the installation was completed in just two hours. Since the installer was a dishwasher expert, he gave me helpful tips on how to maintain my dishwasher. Basically, I think it's best to remove grease before putting it in the dishwasher to avoid any hassle. I mostly use the rinse function, doing the first wash myself and letting the dishwasher do the rinsing. This alone saves me a lot of time and convenience. Saving time on the dishwasher allows me to spend more time playing with my child and conserve energy, so I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher five months now, enough time to get to know the thing.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher you might regret ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher five months now, enough time to get to know the thing. The best thing I can say about it: It cleans really well. But so do dishwashers half the price. Here are the two biggest problems. First, the control buttons feel flimsy. For example, I have to press the on button two or three times to get it to light up and engage. I really do feel it's just a matter of time until the whole control panel has to be replaced, which is not a cheap repair. Second, the rack design is so poorly designed, I can't load dishes like I was used to loading on my old Bosch. That one? I could pretty much fit the dishes from a Thanksgiving meal in. This one? Let's just say the layout of the prongs is so ridiculous that I end up doing way too many of my dishes by hand because it saves time. Seriously, what were you thinking, Bosch? I guess I'm stuck with this thing for a while, but I often wish I had bought something else. Why three stars? As I said, it does clean well. Really really well. So there's some good news. And to end on a positive note, I can fit so few dishes in it, it's a breeze to unload.

Sentence (English): DUE6BG highest specification - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc.,
Comments (English): [ Function: . Originally the highest specification basic model like this ] || ---------------- || Function: . Originally, it was not divided like this for the highest specification basic type, but I will divide it for easy explanation. 1. DUE6BG highest specification - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50% difference from the high specification. Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 standard type - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL basic type - no voice guidance, knife scissor stand in standard type. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Function: . Originally the highest specification basic model like this ] || ---------------- || Function: . Originally, it was not divided like this for the highest specification basic type, but I will divide it for easy explanation. 1. DUE6BG highest specification - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50% difference from the high specification. Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 standard type - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL basic type - no voice guidance, knife scissor stand in standard type. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Originally, it was not divided like this for the highest specification basic type, but I will divide it for easy explanation. 1. DUE6BG highest specification - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50% difference from the high specification. Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 standard type - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL basic type - no voice guidance, knife scissor stand in standard type. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Function: . Originally the highest specification basic model like this ] || ---------------- || Function: . Originally, it was not divided like this for the highest specification basic type, but I will divide it for easy explanation. 1. DUE6BG highest specification - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50% difference from the high specification. Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 standard type - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL basic type - no voice guidance, knife scissor stand in standard type. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Since the event changes frequently, the different prices may be different later. 2. DUE6BGL1 high specification - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 standard type - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL basic type - no voice guidance, knife scissor stand in standard type. The knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center. This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person isn't that big? Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no residue, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that filters food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

This model DUE6BGL1 boasts the same specs as the full option in the 24-year full option, minus the glide rail and lighting. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder:. Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15cm, and 10cm. All other models are based on the 15cm mop holder. I am using a 10cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for full-spec lighting and glide rails, so I just chose the 15cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. 14-person:. I am a newlywed, but I thought a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. It's a given. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it seems that it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Purchasing this dishwasher was an expensive mistake.
Comments (English): [ Interior Design Awful ] || ---------------- || Purchasing this dishwasher was an expensive mistake. I would say that this dishwasher holds 1/2 the capacity of my Kenmore and this is due to the way the tines are set up. The tines in the front of the dishwasher run perpendicular to the tines in the back half of the dishwasher. Loading an oversized cutting board or platter, etc. interferes with the space in the front half of the dishwasher. And if you have several cutting boards that you've used throughout the day, which we always do, you lose the space in the front half of the bottom shelf. There is room in the bottom left lower rack to stand TWO bowls on their side. If you load bowls anywhere else, they flop over and this limits the space you have to load other dishes. My expectation is that I can load my dishwasher with several cutting boards, dinner plates, lunch plates and different-sized bowls, mugs, glasses and large utensils. NO WAY. The top shelf is not that bad but it is difficult to load anything other than glasses. Never room for large utensils (spoons, spatulas, etc.). I'm getting used to the silverware tray but it takes way too much time to load silverware because it has to be placed and spaced properly so that the pieces stand on their side and don't flop over. My preference is to scoop up a handful of silverware from the sink and plop it in a basket. I don't want to fuss with dirty silverware and you have to fuss with this tray design. Once you start loading the silverware in the top tray, there is no room to load larger utensils. The tiny silverware basket is practically useless. I have yet to load an average-sized saucepan because I never have any room to put it. I think it cleans ok. I have noticed that the inside of the door is always spotty with dried drips after the cycle completes. This happens with and without rinse aid. My glasses are clear when the cycle is done. I will say my stainless steel silverwear seems to be dulling. I have to get out "The Pink Stuff" cleaner to shine things up, which I never had to do before, and I don't want to do. I will say it is very quiet. I never thought to closely examine the inside of this machine before I bought it. I'm washing many more dishes than I want to since buying this dishwasher simply because the dishes we use throughout the day don't all fit in it.

Sentence (English): This item has already had problems.
Comments (English): [ Poor design. Dishes are wet. ] || ---------------- || This item has already had problems. The soap dispenser stopped opening and we had to call the Warranty folks. That was not easy, but the review is about the unit and the difficult experience. The serviceman was able to identify the problem with the dispenser and replaced it. But for this price, this should never have happened. But since we are doing the review we wanted others to know about the units shelves. They were designed very poorly. What we would highly recommend is for the customer to bring in dishes to the store so they can see what we are talking about. Because of the design, the dishes lean quite a bit thus, limiting the number of dishes. The spaces are almost 2" and while this may work for plates, it does not work well for salad bowls. The other complaint is the silverware area. It was again, designed poorly in such a way that the silverware drops into the slot, but turns to the left or right resulting in touching other utensils. We like everything to be open for cleaning. Silverware should not touch other silverware and dishes should not touch other dishes. The other problem is the 3rd shelf on the very top. It is a waste of space for us. It says it is for cups and utensils, but we disagree. Again, the way it was designed you cannot put cups in that area unless you lay them down on the side. The utensils are ok, The other complaint is that this area does not dry well. It retains water. When you pull it out, a waterfall trickles down toward the front. Needless to say you have to unload the bottom two shelves first lest you get other clean dishes wet. We miss the old days when quality was essential.

Sentence (English): I bought this unit from Home Depot for a new apartment rental commencing Sept 1.
Comments (English): [ I Choose Whirlpool Over Others, But.  ] || ---------------- || I bought this unit from Home Depot for a new apartment rental commencing Sept 1. The unit was delivered without any problems on Aug 26th. The unit was installed on Aug 27th by a plumber. Once installed the unit was ran in a test mode which lasted about 6-7 minutes. As a result, an error message of E9-F1 was displayed. Apparently this error code implied there was a drainage problem. The unit was pulled out from counter and reexamined for any kinks, pinched areas and connections. No problem was found anywhere in drain line including the garbage disposal that it was connected to. The unit was put back under the counter, assuring no water line and drain line were pinched or kinked. Ran another test mode cycle, with the same error results. A service call was placed and the tech came Sept 11th to check the system out. Diagnostic tests were ran several times of which the unit stopped somewhere within the diagnostic cycle. At this point the tech diagnosed the problem to be a pump (sump) problem. He ordered the new pump and is scheduled to return Sept. 18th to install the new pump. However, the new tenants don't have dishwasher until the unit is fully functional.

Sentence (English): I like that it can use a custom panel - we're still waiting for ours to be cut and installed.
Comments (English): [ My custom-panel dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I like that it can use a custom panel - we're still waiting for ours to be cut and installed. But meanwhile we operate the dishwasher, and just need to be careful to keep the door from swinging shut because there's no extra panel to weigh it down. Overall LIKES: quiet operation, cleans things well, lots of space for cutlery. Main DISLIKE: The buttons are a bit finicky and too reactive. Sometimes I close or open the dishwasher and it inadvertantly starts the operation. Also, the labels for the buttons could be a bit more intuitive so I don't have to refer back to the manual to refresh my memory about which is the most eco-setting, etc.

Sentence (English): Features: . (
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.
Comments (Original): 기능: (원래 최고사양 기본형 이렇게 나누지 않지만 설명하기 쉽게 나눕니다)1. DUE6BG(최고사양)-트루스팀,열풍건조,토네이도세척날개 등 풀스펙, 가장 좋지만 고사양 대비 50가량 차이남(행사가 수시로 바뀌니 차이나는 가격은 이후 다를 수 있음)2. DUE6BGL1(고사양)-풀스펙에서 글라이드레일과 조명없음3. DUE6BGL2(보급형)-고사양에서 프라이팬 거치대없음4. DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc.,
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money!
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): Delivery, eating out for a while.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.
