DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): Just throw them into the 14-person one.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): Water softening function: A function that only LG has.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

DUE6BGL(기본형)-보급형에서 음성안내,칼가위거치대없음(칼가위거치대는 서비스센터에서 몇천원에 구매 가능)이 모델 DUE6BGL1은 24년형 풀옵에서 글라이드 레일과 조명만 빠진 <풀옵션과 동일한 스펙>을 자랑합니다.좀 괜찮은 거 사고 싶은데 가성비 챙겨!! 하는 분들에게 맞는 것 같습니다. 6BG와 6BGL1과는 50이상 차이나지만 6BGL1 밑으로는 금액이 크게 차이 나지 않습니다. 가성비로 풀옵 챙기세요~참고로 DUE5~는 트루스팀, 토네이도세척날개 기능있고 열풍건조 기능없음. 열풍 추가하니 건조도 더 확실히 마무리되어 나와서 좋아요.걸레받이:24년형 기준 최고사양인 DUE6BG만프리스탠딩, 15cm, 10cm 세 가지 선택 가능하고나머지 모든 모델들은 15cm 걸레받이 기준입니다.저는 10cm 걸레받이를 사용하고 있지만 굳이 비용을 더 줘가며 풀스펙(조명 및 글라이드레일포함)으로 하고 싶지 않아서 그냥 15cm 모델로 했지만 설치시 알아서 잘처리해주셨고 알고 선택해서 그러는지 설치 이후 크게 눈에 거슬리지 않습니다.14인용:저는 신혼가구지만 고민 많이 했습니다.이렇게 큰 사이즈가 필요할까? 두 식구면 작은거 해야하는데 너무 불필요한 규모의 식세기가 아닐까?배달, 외식 잠시입니다. 음식해먹게 되면 일단 식세기 클수록 좋습니다.<<거거익선입니다.>>큰거 하세요. 12인용이든 14인용이든 설치하는 규격은 동일한데 사용해보신 분들은 아실거고 첫 사용인분들은 이후 식기를 쌓는 일명 테트리스가 무척 어렵습니다. 14인용 안에 막 던져 넣으세요. 이렇게 편하게 식기 쌓기하실거면 14인용도 그렇게 크지 않습니다(?)연수기능: 엘지만 가진 기능프로땡의 올인원 세제만 사용했을 때 물얼룩이 아주 조금 보여서 프로땡의 린스 사용하니 거의 남지 않는데 보이긴 합니다. 완벽하진 않지만 올인원세제만 사용하셔도 무방할 정도입니다.애벌세척:애벌세척하니 일주일째 음식물 찌꺼기 걸러주는 필터 청소하려고 열어봐도 뭐가 보이지를 않습니다 ㅎ애벌 꼼꼼히 해주시면 식세기 관리가 더 편하실 것 같습니다.

Sentence (English): Pre-washing:.
Comments (English): Features: . (It wasn't originally divided like this, but I'll divide it for easy explanation). 1. DUE6BG (top spec) - full spec with TrueSteam, hot air drying, tornado cleaning blades, etc., the best, but about 50 different from the high spec (the price difference may be different later because the event changes frequently). 2. DUE6BGL1 (high spec) - no glide rail or lighting in full spec. 3. DUE6BGL2 (standard) - no frying pan stand in high spec. 4. DUE6BGL (basic) - no voice guidance, no knife scissor stand in standard type (the knife scissor stand can be purchased for a few thousand won at the service center). This model DUE6BGL1 boasts <same specs as the full option> with only the glide rail and lighting removed from the 24-year full option. It seems to be perfect for those who want to buy something nice but want value for money! There is a difference of more than 50 between 6BG and 6BGL1, but the price difference is not that big below 6BGL1. Get the full option for cost-effectiveness~. For reference, DUE5~ has True Steam, tornado cleaning wing functions, and no hot air drying function. I like it because the addition of hot air makes the drying process more certain. Mop holder: Only DUE6BG, which is the highest specification based on the 24-year model. There are three options: freestanding, 15 cm, and 10 cm. All other models are based on the 15 cm mop holder. I am using a 10 cm mop holder, but I did not want to pay more for the full spec (including lighting and glide rail), so I just went with the 15 cm model, but they took care of it well during installation, and I think they chose it knowingly, so it is not a big eyesore after installation. For 14 people: I am a newlywed, but I worried a lot. Do I need such a large size? I should get a small one for a family of two, but isn't this dishwasher too unnecessary? Delivery, eating out for a while. If you're going to eat out, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. <<It's a big deal.>>. Get a big one. Whether it's a 12-person or 14-person one, the installation specifications are the same, but those who have used it will know that it's very difficult for first-time users to stack dishes, aka Tetris. Just throw them into the 14-person one. If you're going to stack dishes this easily, the 14-person one isn't that big either(?). Water softening function: A function that only LG has. When I only used Protain's all-in-one detergent, water stains were visible, so when I used Protain's rinse, there was almost no stain left, but it was visible. It's not perfect, but it's okay to use only the all-in-one detergent. Pre-washing:. After pre-washing, I opened the filter that catches food waste for a week to clean it, but I couldn't see anything. If you pre-wash thoroughly, it will be easier to maintain the dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Sentence (English): September 15, 2024.
Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Sentence (English): Thank you to everyone reading this long post.
Comments (English): [ oh.  ] || ---------------- || There is no detergent dispenser. It was in the manual, though. This is my first 6-place setting dishwasher ever. I was going to buy a Samsung, but then I realized Samsung is a Midea product, so I bought this one right away. (It’s no secret that the price difference is about 200,000 won just for the brand value.) It comes with a 2-year free warranty, so I plan to use it for two years, and if it’s not good, I’ll switch to a built-in model. For now, I like that it has UV sterilization, and the sound doesn't seem as loud as I expected. (Though it is a bit loud.) Plus, I like it even more because you can see inside to check if it's working properly. I was so grateful to the installation technician for working so hard, even while sweating profusely. (I tried to give him some ice cream, but he refused, saying it would make me gain weight.) I will write a more detailed review after using it a bit more. ------------------------------------. September 15, 2024. I contacted the AS center because the drying wasn't working well. It seems the only drying function is the automatic door opening. Chili powder soaked in grease barely washes off. (I rinsed it in hot water before putting it in.) It takes over 5 hours for the dishes to dry even after I take the basket out completely after the dishwasher finishes. I am currently very flustered and regretful. I want to return it. ------------------------------------. 2024. 10. 23. I just accepted the drying issue. However, moisture is accumulating on the front transparent door. How do I get this out? Ah. I thought it might be due to a temperature difference, so I tried all sorts of things. I tried them all, but nothing worked. I'm doomed. If I had known this would happen, I should have bought an older model. I bought the new one for nothing. Typical China. . ------------------------------------. 2025. 9. 2. It will be almost a year since I started using it. The moisture still hasn't gone away. It feels like the moisture will last a lifetime. I've developed some know-how regarding drying. The moment I hear the notification sound at night—which reminds me of a horror movie—I shake the water out of the dishes thoroughly, and they are dry the next morning. If I don't shake them out, they won't dry at all, to the point where mosquitoes would be taking a hot spring bath. The detergent also stops working if there is too much foam. I guess this is why people rave about domestic products. Also, you must pre-rinse the dishes thoroughly (until there isn't a single speck of dust like chili powder or rice grains) before putting them in the dishwasher to see clean dishes. ------------------------------------. Dec. 26, 2025. I called a technician because the E4 error code kept appearing. I actually called him twice, and since E4 appeared both times, I called him again. This time, he fixed the E4 error, but a leak occurred on the floor. The technician gave up, saying this couldn't be fixed and I should reach an agreement with Coupang. I used it for a little over 1 year and 3 months, trusting the 2-year free repair warranty, but I wasted my money. Thank you to everyone reading this long post. Conclusion: Don't buy it!

Sentence (English): Coming from an old dishwasher that barely washed pre-scrubbed dishes and would try to wash using no water if you weren't careful setting it, this Bosch has been a god send!
Comments (English): [ Splendid upgrade - actually washes dishes! ] || ---------------- || Coming from an old dishwasher that barely washed pre-scrubbed dishes and would try to wash using no water if you weren't careful setting it, this Bosch has been a god send! Most dishes require little to no prep (aside from scraping off large chunks) and come out super clean. It's also sooooo quiet compared to what I'm used to. Everything about just seems to. work. Which is incrible to me. Having extra control and notifications through the Home Connect app is an incredible bonus, as well. Now I know when the dishes are ready to be unloaded even if I'm in another room, our out and about. And I don't have to try to figure out how to make the buttons on the front do what I want - I can just set everything up in the app and let it rip! I do have a couple of complaints that knock off a star (and maybe these are options that could have been chosen differently, but we were gifted it by a family member, so not sure): 1) The top rack is soooooo low down. We had opted not to get the super slim top drawer in the hopes that we could raise the top rack up further, but no dice. With the rack at its highest, we are *barely* able to fit one single large cookie sheet per wash, and we have to be careful about how it's loaded otherwise it interferes with the spinner on the bottom of the top rack. 2) There are some weird options for "spokes" on both the top and bottom rack. Some of them are way too close together for normal items, making it difficult to load things efficiantly in those areas. These parts do fold down, but that's only so helpful. It can still be hard to load pots on top of them as they create a kind of bump, and if I have a lot of plates, well. I need the spoke things. Overall, though, a thousand times better than what we had before! Saves tons tons of time not having to scrub every dish before loading, and I imagine it's way more water and energy efficiant compared to our old one on account of it being way newer.

Sentence (English): This is what it's like to buy appliances from BestBuy.
Comments (English): [ Buying from you has been a horrible experience ] || ---------------- || This is what it's like to buy appliances from BestBuy. My landlord, who lives abroad, asked that we go and find a new range/oven, fridge, and dishwasher for the apartment. We found moderately good prices at BestBuy (don't try to buy at their outlet, they don't actually have what they advertise that they have, it's in a different state, and also you have to go pick it up, no delivery available). The dishwasher was an open box floor model that was missing a spring and therefore pretty heavily discounted. I figured, I'll buy a spring and install it, so I got it. Delivery and installation was scheduled for later that week. A bunch of confirmation emails later the day arrives, and early in the morning I get a call from the delivery company. \"Our driver went to the warehouse; the dishwasher wasn't there. You're only getting the fridge today.\" Okay, so I call bestbuy. You can't reach the store directly. The people on the phone won't let you speak to a supervisor. I'm told that, because some of the delivery (the fridge) is on its way, I can't speak to them about other items in the delivery. Several calls and a few hours later I speak to the fourth BestBuy associate of the day who determines that the dishwasher is, indeed, at the warehouse, but they don't want to deliver it in that condition so they're getting a spring for it. I guess that sounds good, but they could have done that beforehand. But here we are, so we schedule the range/oven and dishwasher for delivery when I return from a business trip abroad. The day approaches, I get the confirmation emails, and wouldn't you know it, the morning of the delivery I get a call from the delivery company. \"Our driver went to the warehouse; the dishwasher wasn't there. You're only getting the range today.\" We're now almost a month out from the purchase date. The range arrives and is installed, and the folks from this company repeat that they went to the warehouse and the dishwasher wasn't there. I call, speak to a couple of people. Now they're offering to escalate the case to a team that will review it, and also offer me compensation because they've failed to deliver the item twice. They say the team will contact me in 24 hours. They don't. I call again - \"the delivery guys didn't close out the order after delivering the range, and we need to escalate again. 24-48 hours, you'll hear from us.\" I don't. 72 hours later I call. The guy sounds puzzled, \"why is this happening? Well, anyway, I can schedule the delivery for this Friday.\" I agree. On Wednesday, a day after calling, I get an email: \"Your Order Delivery Needs to be Scheduled.\" I try entering my account. Cannot remember ever having used a password, so I choose the option \"connect with Apple ID.\" That goes through - to a page that says \"please enter your password.\" So I call again - he scheduled the installation, not the delivery. Now Friday isn't available anymore. The delivery is scheduled for next week. The website contains incomplete and misleading information. The associates are inept. No one seems to acknowledge the mess they've created. I have to chase after them when they have said they will follow up within a set amount of time. And the dishwasher? I bet you that if I went to the store where I bought it, it would be sitting right there, on the floor, where I saw it and where a salesperson sold it to me.

Sentence (English): This is what it's like to buy appliances from BestBuy.
Comments (English): [ Buying from you has been a horrible experience ] || ---------------- || This is what it's like to buy appliances from BestBuy.My landlord, who lives abroad, asked that we go and find a new range/oven, fridge, and dishwasher for the apartment. We found moderately good prices at BestBuy (don't try to buy at their outlet, they don't actually have what they advertise that they have, it's in a different state, and also you have to go pick it up, no delivery available). The dishwasher was an open box floor model that was missing a spring and therefore pretty heavily discounted. I figured, I'll buy a spring and install it, so I got it. Delivery and installation was scheduled for later that week. A bunch of confirmation emails later the day arrives, and early in the morning I get a call from the delivery company. "Our driver went to the warehouse; the dishwasher wasn't there. You're only getting the fridge today." Okay, so I call bestbuy. You can't reach the store directly. The people on the phone won't let you speak to a supervisor. I'm told that, because some of the delivery (the fridge) is on its way, I can't speak to them about other items in the delivery. Several calls and a few hours later I speak to the fourth BestBuy associate of the day who determines that the dishwasher is, indeed, at the warehouse, but they don't want to deliver it in that condition so they're getting a spring for it. I guess that sounds good, but they could have done that beforehand. But here we are, so we schedule the range/oven and dishwasher for delivery when I return from a business trip abroad.The day approaches, I get the confirmation emails, and wouldn't you know it, the morning of the delivery I get a call from the delivery company. "Our driver went to the warehouse; the dishwasher wasn't there. You're only getting the range today." We're now almost a month out from the purchase date. The range arrives and is installed, and the folks from this company repeat that they went to the warehouse and the dishwasher wasn't there. I call, speak to a couple of people. Now they're offering to escalate the case to a team that will review it, and also offer me compensation because they've failed to deliver the item twice. They say the team will contact me in 24 hours. They don't. I call again - "the delivery guys didn't close out the order after delivering the range, and we need to escalate again. 24-48 hours, you'll hear from us." I don't. 72 hours later I call. The guy sounds puzzled, "why is this happening? Well, anyway, I can schedule the delivery for this Friday." I agree. On Wednesday, a day after calling, I get an email: "Your Order Delivery Needs to be Scheduled." I try entering my account. Cannot remember ever having used a password, so I choose the option "connect with Apple ID." That goes through - to a page that says "please enter your password." So I call again - he scheduled the installation, not the delivery. Now Friday isn't available anymore. The delivery is scheduled for next week.The website contains incomplete and misleading information. The associates are inept. No one seems to acknowledge the mess they've created. I have to chase after them when they have said they will follow up within a set amount of time. And the dishwasher? I bet you that if I went to the store where I bought it, it would be sitting right there, on the floor, where I saw it and where a salesperson sold it to me.

However, it has a very limited space to fit all the dishes that it potentially could. The middle rack will need to be moved into the highest position if you plan on washing normal size dinner plates. The spinning sprayer attaches to the bottom of the middle rack and it hits plates if it is not locked into the highest position. It's a pretty crappy design.

Comments (English): [ Not impressed so far ] || ---------------- || Installed my unit a few days ago.
