Not impressed so far. I should have looked harder at the Kitchenaide. Oh, and it's louder than I thought it would be, not too bad, but not as good as I expected from experience with previous Bosch washers.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for *maybe* 3 years.
Comments (English): [ Poor Design? Bad Unit? ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for *maybe* 3 years. It's been one yearly MAJOR issue after another since install. We've already had at least two mother board failures, one year apart. We encountered a separate major issue 3 months before that. I've already paid more in service fees than I paid for the unit, and that hurts to write. A couple wheels broke off the rack which we were able to fix, but now our bottom rack does not stay on track. The unit seemed quiet at first but over time it gets louder and louder. I've had to contact LG at least once per year to get this fixed and now suddenly in September of 2024 they tell me that the only way they will dispatch a tech to investigate that I have to pay a flat fee of ~$350 upfront. Mind you they don't even know what the issue is. Also I did not have to pay this last year, when my unit was still out of warranty as it is now which is the reason they claim to charge this. That's a strange repair tactic to me and it's taking money without any real concern for why this keeps happening. There is obviously a design flaw in this unit (or this model, based on reading other reviews of people who have encountered the same exact problems as me) and NO ONE cares that this KEEPS happening. So instead of paying $350, I'm going to go purchase a new unit that is NOT LG so I don't have to keep paying year after year for a unit that should work and to a company that does not care. I have written a message "to the president" (lol, doubtful it actually goes there. ) and sent a message on instagram to LG support. contacting support through "social media" is another odd tactic, but it's what I see LG responding with to other reviews on this site so I will at least try. I would appreciate an acknowledgement and a way to make this right as I'm clearly not the only one experiencing these issues. I used to like LG products but now I'll be staying away from them in my home.

During the holidays It is really useful when washing dishes left after serving. During the holidays It is really useful when washing dishes left after serving. If the dishes overlap, it may not be washed well, so keep the dishes spaced out so that the water touches all the dishes evenly and washes them smoothly. Above all, it is important to periodically clean the internal filter to prevent bad smells or malfunctions. Comments (English): When I first bought a dishwasher as a newlywed, I used a compact size that was not too burdensome, but as I had one or two children, there was not enough space to put dishes, cups, and pots. My own tip for using it is that the dishwasher can often smell, but to prevent this, you can pre-wash the dishes and put them in the dishwasher. When odor-causing substances in food are created, bad odors or fishy smells occur, but pre-washing eggs or fish and running the dishwasher helps block the smell. During the holidays It is really useful when washing dishes left after serving. If the dishes overlap, it may not be washed well, so keep the dishes spaced out so that the water touches all the dishes evenly and washes them smoothly. Above all, it is important to periodically clean the internal filter to prevent bad smells or malfunctions. The most convenient and reliable way is to use a care service that manages everything from water hardness settings to clean every corner. :) These days, it is common knowledge that washing machines and dryers do laundry, robot vacuum cleaners do cleaning, and induction cookers do cooking quickly and safely, but many people still do the dishes by hand. Sentence (English): The dishwasher I really wanted to buy when I move~!
Comments (English): The dishwasher I really wanted to buy when I move~! First of all, it was nice that I could order it and immediately specify the delivery date. I bought it on Coupang on Sunday afternoon and was hoping to receive it on Tuesday, but LG let me choose my desired date, and the technician called me the day before his visit~ to coordinate an available installation time~! ^^ The technician was kind and explained the installation fee separately~ He said that the price may vary depending on the house and that the installation fee would be around 13-15~ I already knew that the installation fee would be added~! ^^ I used it about 3 times and it was all new, but the best part was that after it was thoroughly washed with the automatic door opening dryer, the door automatically opens when it reaches a safe temperature to release moisture and odor~! ^^They say that if you stack them well, you can fit up to 110, but it seems like it's still under 30. I don't think it's 100% dry yet because of the lack of technology. There are some that are 80-90% dry, but there are also some that are wet so you can wipe them off. This is the new world adaptation period for a 13-year housewife who used to sweat when washing dishes with hot water.
